description: This file defines Express routes for development and debugging purposes, including endpoints to check MongoDB connection status, seed the database with sample data, and verify data across collections. It imports models for various entities like User, Sample, Tenant, Project, SessionTracking, and AppDeployment, and sets up route handlers for specific API endpoints.

methods.name: router.get('/db-status')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve MongoDB connection status, including connection state, database name, and host.

methods.name: router.get('/seed')
methods.description: Endpoint to seed the database with sample data for users, samples, tenants, projects, session tracking, and app deployments if collections are empty.

methods.name: router.get('/verify')
methods.description: Endpoint to verify data availability by returning counts and sample documents from all collections.
